prompt: Some children spend hours every day on their smartphones. Why is this the case? Do you think this is a positive or a negative development?
essay:
Nowadays, plenty of kids use their tablets and consoles every day for many hours. This statement means their parents do not care about their children. Also, from my perspective, I strongly disagree that tablets are developing their logic or creativity.

On the one hand, those children might be playing a game that may develop their minds. Moreover, not all the games are the same; some of them are shooting or harassing humans. Otherwise, there are plenty of games that can impact positively, such as Minecraft. For example, in Minecraft, in this game, you can do anything; you can build whatever you want, which means this can develop your creativity in architecture. Furthermore, some educational centres are using Minecraft in their education system. Because they know that the game will affect their children positively.

On the other hand, watching the screen for many hours can make them cosy. Although that screen is killing their brains, and the reason is they will adapt to that comfort, and it can lead them into laziness, which they do not want to do anything less watching their tablets or TV. This will cause a big problem for them.Moreover, they will not learn about hard work. Because they just adapt to that comfort. And, suddenly, their parents let them do anything. Unfortunately, they do not know how to do it.That is why it will affect them negatively.

In conclusion, your kids can watch their electronic devices, but not all the time or else your kids will turn into lazy people. So, be responsible for your kids and their future.
